overview.what: Admin console. Overview shows drafts and upcoming publishes, then notes, media, feeds, and import/export.
overview.chain:
① Pick a page on the left.
② On Overview, resume drafts or check upcoming publishes.
③ Write, delete, or recategorize notes.
④ Add, refresh, or sort feeds.
overview.frontend: The feed wall, note wall, and friends page use sources and categories you change here.

notes.what: Note list. Open, delete, cancel a schedule, or batch-add a category.
notes.chain:
① Open a title to edit.
② Edit mode selects many for delete or category.
③ Two categories max.
notes.frontend: Published notes hit the note wall. They enter the public RSS only after you turn it on. Scheduled ones go out on time.
notes.notes: Body and cover stay in the editor. A third category prompts that it is full.

media.what: Uploaded images and video, plus generated files.
media.chain:
① Upload into the library.
② Filter by format, source, or use.
③ Delete only unused files.
media.frontend: Note covers and site images reference these files.
media.notes: Files still in use cannot be deleted.

sources.what: Add, edit, refresh, delete feeds, turn on notes RSS, and set default sort.
sources.chain:
① Add or refresh.
② Default sort is stored on this device.
③ Notes RSS is off by default; turn it on before sharing.
④ Two categories max.
sources.frontend: The feed wall uses this sort and these categories.
sources.notes: The feed wall is for reading. Delete sources here.

add.what: Add a feed or a plain link.
add.chain:
① Pick a type.
② Enter the address.
③ Category is optional.
add.frontend: New items appear on the feed wall or friends page.
add.notes: Bulk lists go through Import / Export.

noteCategories.what: Note category names. Filters and batch-add use these.
noteCategories.chain:
① Create or rename.
② Deleting a name strips that part only.
③ Friend Links / Me are not on this page.
noteCategories.frontend: The note wall and this list filter by these names.

sourceCategories.what: Feed category names, including presets Friend Links and Me.
sourceCategories.chain:
① Create or rename.
② Deleting a name strips that part only.
③ Presets cannot be changed or deleted.
sourceCategories.frontend: Friend Links sources appear on friends. RSS also stays on the feed wall.

rsshub.what: RSSHub instances used when you subscribe to a route.
rsshub.chain:
① Add an instance URL.
② RSSHub subscriptions use these.
③ Check health or change the default.
rsshub.frontend: Shown when you add an RSSHub feed.
rsshub.notes: A down instance means those feeds will not fetch.

notesIo.chain:
① Pick a format.
② Drop a file, then start import.
③ Export packs the current notes.
notesIo.frontend: Imports land in the note list for edit and publish.
notesIo.notes: WordPress uses WXR. Halo uses JSON or a Markdown zip. Typecho uses backup XML and also accepts WXR.

feedsIo.chain:
① Brewpack backs up the whole set.
② OPML exchanges lists with other readers.
③ Drop a file, then start import.
feedsIo.frontend: Imported sources appear on the feed wall.
feedsIo.notes: Brewpack keeps source settings. OPML is mostly addresses.

defaultSort.what: Default order of the feed wall.
defaultSort.chain:
① Change it here.
② Stored on this device.
③ The feed wall opens in this order.
defaultSort.frontend: Source order on the feed wall.
defaultSort.notes: Not tied to the account. Reset it in another browser.

wordpress.chain:
① Drop a .xml / .wxr file.
② Start import.
③ Or export current notes.
wordpress.frontend: Imports land in the note list.
wordpress.notes: Notes only. Site settings stay behind.

halo.what: Halo post JSON, or a Markdown zip.
halo.chain:
① Drop a .json or .zip file.
② Start import.
③ Or export in the same format.
halo.frontend: Imports land in the note list.
halo.notes: The zip should contain Markdown files.

typecho.chain:
① Drop a .xml file.
② Start import.
③ Or export notes.
typecho.frontend: Imports land in the note list.

markdown.what: .md files with YAML front matter, or a zip of them.
markdown.chain:
① Drop a .md or .zip file.
② Start import.
③ Or export in the same format.
markdown.frontend: Imports land in the note list.
markdown.notes: Front matter becomes title, category, and similar fields.

brewpack.what: Back up and restore the whole subscription set.
brewpack.chain:
① Export a brewpack.
② Or drop a .brewpack / .zip file.
③ Start import.
brewpack.frontend: Imported sources appear on the feed wall.
brewpack.notes: Source settings travel with the pack.

opml.what: Exchange subscription lists with other readers.
opml.chain:
① Export OPML.
② Or drop an .opml file.
③ Start import.
opml.frontend: Imported addresses appear on the feed wall.
opml.notes: Mostly addresses. Extra settings may drop.
